step1_figure.circuit_type: Switched-Capacitor Sample-and-Hold using Two-Stage Fully-Differential Op-Amp with SC CMFB
step1_figure.description: The netlist implements the complete switched-capacitor sample-and-hold circuit shown in Fig. 26.58, comprising the bias generator (Fig. 26.52), the first-stage diff-amp with SC CMFB (Fig. 26.54), the second-stage output buffer with SC CMFB (Fig. 26.56), and switched sampling/hold capacitors driven by non-overlapping clocks phi1 and phi2.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Op-amp unity-gain frequency determined by the first-stage input transconductance and Miller compensation capacitance

equation.explanation: The unity-gain frequency of the Miller-compensated two-stage op-amp is set by the transconductance of the input differential pair (gm) and the compensation capacitor (Cc = 12.5 fF).
equation.assumptions: Diff-pair operates in saturation with balanced quiescent current.

sky130_expected.calculation: For Sky130 NMOS diff-pair with W/L = 6.0u/0.15u (width scaled up by 4 from 10/1), I_D ≈ 10 uA per branch: gm = sqrt(2 * un*Cox * (W/L) * I_D) = sqrt(2 * 270u * (6.0/0.15) * 10u) = sqrt(2.16e-7) ≈ 0.465 mA/V. Cc = 12.5 fF. fun = 0.465e-3 / (2 * pi * 12.5e-15) ≈ 5.92 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High transconductance with low compensation capacitance (12.5 fF) places the unity-gain frequency in the gigahertz range in 130 nm CMOS.

settling_time.description: Time required for the differential output (Voutp - Voutm) to settle to within 1% of final value during the hold phase (phi2 high)

source.reference: Text on page 903: 'The settling time, as seen in (b), is < 3 ns.'

equation.explanation: With the output buffer device widths increased by 4x and compensation capacitance decreased to 12.5 fF, the second pole f2 is pushed out, allowing the op-amp closed-loop follower to settle in less than 3 ns.
equation.assumptions: Non-overlapping clocks operating at 10 MHz; step input applied during phi2 phase.

sky130_expected.calculation: With closed-loop bandwidth ~ 1 to 2 GHz and minimal phase delay from high f2, 4 time constants tau = 1/(2*pi*f_cl) ≈ 4 * 160 ps ≈ 0.64 ns plus slew time ≈ 1.5 ns gives settling time < 3 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Textbook specifies settling time < 3 ns for the 4x widened diff-pair and buffer topology.

diff_amp_output_cm.description: DC common-mode voltage at the outputs of the first-stage diff-amp (Vopd + Vomd)/2

equation.explanation: The switched-capacitor CMFB circuit around the first stage diff-amp sets its output common-mode level to Vbias1.
equation.assumptions: SC CMFB switched network is fully settled and clock feedthrough is negligible.

sky130_expected.calculation: Vbias1 is generated by diode-connected PMOS stack referenced to VDD. For VDD = 1.8V, Vbias1 settles to approximately 0.6 V to 0.7 V depending on bias branch currents.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Text notes Vbias1 is roughly 600 mV to balance saturation voltage across cascode transistors.

output_cm_voltage.description: Common-mode voltage at the output buffer (Vop + Vom)/2

equation.explanation: The output buffer SC CMFB circuit forces the output common-mode voltage to track the reference voltage VCM (set to 500 mV or VDD/2).
equation.assumptions: Switched-capacitor CMFB operating over several clock cycles to steady state.

sky130_expected.calculation: In the netlist VCM is held at 0.5 V (500 mV). The SC CMFB network charges toward this reference.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SC CMFB samples and holds common-mode error to enforce V_out,cm = VCM.

diff_amp_cmfb_control_voltage.description: Steady-state control voltage generated by the first-stage SC CMFB network (VCMFB1)

equation.explanation: To balance the tail currents of the diff-amp, the SC CMFB output adjusts so that the CMFB-controlled tail transistor mirrors the reference bias current established by Vbiasn.
equation.assumptions: Balanced tail devices with equal aspect ratios.

sky130_expected.calculation: For Sky130 NMOS with Vth ≈ 0.42V carrying ~10 uA with W/L = 1.5u/0.15u: Vov = sqrt(2 * 10u / (270u * 10)) ≈ 0.086 V; V_biasn = Vth + Vov ≈ 0.51 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Tail current source gates must be biased slightly above NMOS threshold voltage.

differential_output_swing.description: Peak-to-peak differential output voltage tracking the differential input signal

equation.formula: V_diff,pp = max(Voutp - Voutm) - min(Voutp - Voutm) ≈ 0.6 V
equation.explanation: The differential input amplitude is 2 * 0.3 V = 0.6 V peak-to-peak. In unity-gain follower configuration, the differential output tracks this amplitude.
equation.assumptions: Closed-loop gain of follower is nominally 1.0.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_diff = 2 * 0.3 V = 0.6 V peak-to-peak sinusoidal envelope sampled at 10 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sample-and-hold follower configuration with high DC gain provides unity gain.

step3_testbench.description: Transient simulation of the switched-capacitor sample-and-hold circuit implementing the two-stage fully-differential op-amp with SC CMFB as shown in Fig. 26.58. Measures differential output tracking, settling time, and common-mode voltages.
